run_process_intro_sents: run the script to extract up to 10 introductory sentences per title from full text data
run_sentence_tokenization: run NLTK punkt sentence tokenization on Wikipedia article full text and store top 10 sentences
run_enrich_parsed_objects: run the script to enrich parsed title objects with introductory sentence descriptions from full text
run_filter_section_titles: run the script to filter out section titles and blank lines before tokenizing sentences
run_dump_enriched_pickle: run the script to dump enriched parsed objects with intro sentences to a pickle file
